dct_description_sm: The Chlorophyll a layer provides the near-surface concentration of chlorophyll a in milligrams of chlorophyll pigment per cubic meter (mg/m³) in the ocean.
The MERIS Chlorophyll a product was available from the ENVISAT satellite. The sensor resolution was 1.2 km and imagery resolution was 1 km, and the temporal resolution was daily.

MERIS (Medium Resolution Imaging Spectrometer) was a programmable, medium-spectral resolution, imaging spectrometer operating in the solar reflective spectral range aboard the ENVISAT satellite. It was operational from 2002 to 2012.

A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), covering 2002-04-29 to 2012-04-08. Made from ENVISAT MERIS Level-2 Regional Reduced Resolution (RR) Ocean Color (OC) Data, version 2022.0 (MERIS_L2_RR_OC, version 2022.0, doi:10.5067/ENVISAT/MERIS/L2/RR/OC/2022.0).
